name: Hahn
note: Rating note for maintainer (Concern proposed): Hahn is a Lion beer brand (hahn-lion-ownership); Lion is 100% owned by Japan's Kirin Holdings (lion-kirin-ownership); a UN fact-finding mission documented that Kirin-owned Singapore companies held 51% of Myanmar Brewery and Mandalay Brewery, joint ventures with MEHL, the Myanmar military's conglomerate, and that Kirin donated at a September 2017 Tatmadaw fundraising ceremony (kirin-myanmar-mehl; Amnesty 2020 and HRW 2022 concur). Precedent: the POSCO concern decision (October 2026) counts a UN-documented joint venture with a military's business conglomerate. Kirin said in February 2022 it would withdraw from Myanmar. Hahn became an official sponsor of Ripper GC in February 2026 (Mediaweek, 2026-02-03).
